Reentrancy in EtherBank.withdraw() (src/EtherBank.sol#19-26):
	External calls:
	- (ok,None) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}() (src/EtherBank.sol#22)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] = 0 (src/EtherBank.sol#24)
	EtherBank.balances (src/EtherBank.sol#8) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- EtherBank.balances (src/EtherBank.sol#8)
	- EtherBank.deposit() (src/EtherBank.sol#13-17)
	- EtherBank.withdraw() (src/EtherBank.sol#19-26)
